title: Far and Near the Fields Are Teeming
lyrics: [F]Far and near the [Bb]fields are teeming [F]with the sheaves of [G7]ripened [C]grain;
[F]Far and near their [Bb]gold is gleaming [F]O'er the [Bb]sunny [F]slope [C7]and [F]plain.
[F]Lord of harvest, [C7]send forth reapers! [F]Hear us Lord, to [Bb]Thee we [C]cry;
[F]Send them now the [Bb]sheaves to gather, [F]Ere the [Bb]harvesttime [C7]pass [F]by.
Send them forth with morn's first beaming,
Send them in the noon-tides's glare;
When the sun's last rays are streaming,
O thou, whom thy Lord is sending,
gather now the sheaves of gold;
Thou shalt come with joy untold.
